hero_kpi_rationale: Resilient operating margin of 20.0% despite volume decline, reflecting operational discipline through the Carlisle Operating System (COS) and structural stability of the repair and remodel market (70% of CCM portfolio).

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin declined in 2025 to 20.0% from 22.8% in 2024, primarily due to lower fixed cost absorption and higher innovation costs.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total annual sales of the company.
kpis.description: Revenue reached $5.02 billion in 2025, a slight organic increase of +0.3%, driven by acquisitions in the CWT segment (MTL, PFB, ThermaFoam, Bonded Logic).
kpis.signal: Near-zero organic growth, driven by acquisitions.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Margin after cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined to 35.7% in 2025 from 37.7% in 2024, due to lower fixed cost absorption on reduced volumes.
kpis.signal: Margin pressure due to fixed cost absorption on lower volumes.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses reached $47.1 million in 2025, or 0.9% of revenue, up 33.1%, in line with the Vision 2030 strategy focused on new product development.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in R&D spending for innovation aligned with Vision 2030.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before depreciation and amortization, adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA was $1.225 billion in 2025, down 8% from 2024 ($1.333 billion), primarily due to margin pressure and acquisition integration costs.
kpis.signal: Significant decline due to margin pressure and integration costs.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core business operations.
kpis.description: The company generated over $1 billion in operating cash flow in 2025, strengthening its financial flexibility and share repurchase capacity.
kpis.signal: Strong cash generation despite challenging conditions.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €6.26 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €2.88 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Repair and Remodel Market Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue derived from repair and remodel activity versus new construction.
kpis.description: The repair and remodel market represents approximately 70% of the CCM segment's revenue, a key pillar of Carlisle's resilience against new construction cycles.
kpis.signal: Core business relies on a recurring and resilient market.

kpis.name: Acquisition-Driven Growth
kpis.explanation: Contribution of recent acquisitions to revenue growth.
kpis.description: In 2025, acquisitions (MTL, PFB, ThermaFoam, Bonded Logic) contributed +3.2% to revenue growth, versus -2.9% organically, demonstrating the effectiveness of the M&A strategy.
kpis.signal: Acquisitions offset weakness in organic markets.

risks.title: Dependence on Acquisitions
risks.summary: The company relies heavily on acquisitions for growth, which carries significant risks.
risks.score_rationale: The company's growth strategy depends in part on the successful acquisition and integration of other businesses. Acquisitions involve numerous risks, including failure to realize expected synergies and integration failures.

risks.title: Loss of Key Customers
risks.summary: The loss of key customers could have severe consequences due to the company's reliance on them.
risks.score_rationale: The loss of one or more key customers could negatively impact the company, as certain segments operate in niche markets where a large portion of revenue comes from a few major customers.

risks.title: Manufacturing Risks
risks.summary: Manufacturing-related risks, such as damage or disruptions, could significantly impact the company.
risks.score_rationale: The company could be affected by significant damage or prolonged disruption to its manufacturing facilities, potentially resulting in uninsured losses and liabilities.

risks.title: New Product Development
risks.summary: The company must innovate and develop new products to remain competitive, but this involves risks and challenges.
risks.score_rationale: The development and introduction of new products are critical to the Vision 2030 strategy, but there are risks related to timing, costs, and commercial success of these new products.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Risks
risks.summary: Macroeconomic conditions can significantly impact the company, particularly due to its reliance on the construction market.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to macroeconomic risks such as fluctuations in interest rates, inflation, tariffs, and credit availability, which can affect demand for its products.

ai_positioning.summary: The company CSL has no significant mentions related to artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F report. Its business appears focused on areas such as building materials and sealing technologies.
